paragraphs.text: The Official Urza's Legacy Game Guide is a guide to the cards in Urza's Legacy Magic: The Gathering set. It is a softcover paperback with 74 pages, written by Will McDermott , editor of The Duelist at the time. It was published by Wizards of the Coast on April 1, 1999.
Card summaries and strategy tips for players are included in this comprehensive guide to the cards of Urza's Legacy , the Magic: The Gathering February 1999 expansion.
Along with a rebranding to "Game Guide", this was the first expansion guide published in-house by Wizards of the Coast .
